title.rendered: 1900 Boys Pay Girls EXTRA Slay – Special Guest: Michael

content.rendered:

Get ready to dress to slay and immerse yourself in an explosive set by our special guest, Michael.

💃 Free Entrance all night + Buffet Drinks before midnight for Ladies

🎫 Entrance Coupon for man: 300K (Buffet drinks included before midnight)
